column1: # CSS cascade memory regression baseline
# Captured on 2026-09-18 with the arm64 macOS standard host via
# `make test-css-cascade-memory`. The existing standard configuration selected
# a release host for this capture; the target itself does not force a build
# mode. The workload runs page load then one clean
# full recascade. It checks the CSS-role/canonical pools and the document-pool
# allocation caused by each cascade; the latter is where owned specified-style
# retention is observable. Payload totals ensure recipe sharing does not
# regress into one deep declaration snapshot per canonical entry, while the
# cold-cache totals ensure this steady-state workload retains no optional
# history. This follows D4.1.4v4, D4.2.1v3-D4.2.5v3, and
# D4.5.1v3: pool lifetime and allocator attribution remain explicit.
# The fixture set covers library-selector breadth (jqueryui), large external
# stylesheet input (linuxmint), repeated content cards (netflix), a high-DOM
# Bootstrap document, and two independently packaged web templates. Values are
# bytes except entries, bound_refs, payloads, payload_refs, and bound_entries.
# The GTest allows 15% plus 4 KiB for pool extent rounding; structural counts
# and cold-cache storage are strict ceilings. A recascade must not grow
# canonical CSS beyond that margin.
# fixture phase document_live document_live_delta work_live_delta css_live canonical_live canonical_live_delta entries bound_refs payloads payload_refs bound_entries cold_entries cold_bytes
